uncertainties: Fariel's abandoned promise is deliberately unspecified. No detail added.
text:
Th-that's why...
I'd kept it a secret
from you all this time...
No, it's just...
the story was
so well put together.
That's not it. I was
surprised because the story
was so well put together...
...Huh?
Yes, really.
I was thinking I'd like
to use it in our textbook...
I never knew, Alieze,
that you had a talent like this.
What a surprise!
Yes, really.
I was thinking I'd like
to use it in our textbook...
I never knew, Alieze,
that you had a talent like this.
What a surprise!
Oh, no...
It's nothing like that...
No, it's wonderful.
Really...
No, it's wonderful!
Really, it is...
Kyupi, kyupi! ♪
...
That's absurd!
Huh...?
Then what becomes
of everything you've
struggled for until now!?
I'm sorry...
Phlaiz...
But I've already decided.
I'm giving up.
Lady Fariel...
It's true. I've always wished
to finally keep
that unfulfilled promise.
And I've asked you
to do so much for me.
Thank you. Truly.
Phlaiz...
No, all I did
was lend you
a little help.
Your soul was able
to remain in this world
only because of that powerful wish.
But if you
abandon that wish,
you will...
It's all right...
I'm already dead. I can't
trouble the living
with my selfish wishes.
...Can I?
Lady Fariel...
I should go...
This is surely
not a conversation
I have any right to intrude on.
This is surely
not a conversation
I have any right to intrude on.
I'll forget I heard it...
Not here, huh...
I thought Yafha
might have some good advice,
but there's nothing I can do...
Not here, then...

but there's nothing I can do...
Hm?
Ghh, ugh...!
